value.residual: The closed Rust EntityIR validator and the production commit checker reject every unknown payload/schema keyword; the admitted field language is type/required plus exact finite string enums. The finite reasoner/SHACL corpus is checked, and versioned authoritative object/relation commits require exact Active ontology artifacts and revalidate that same bounded field language before publishing effects. Lean proves the declared evidence-type separation, but no implementation correspondence or end-to-end inferred-triple negative test exists; no general OWL soundness/completeness theorem is claimed.
